source_scope: green-source-v2: explicit source overlay on earlier combined CPU archive; not a complete current-main GPU qualification

red.cause: Previous publications did not bind checkpoint metadata to the atomic move receipt; recovery attempted numerical reads after eviction. Earlier red-v1 also retained a fixture setup error; red-v2 corrected only that fixture control.

behavior: New durable publications bind versioned snapshot, payload, model and execution identities to their existing atomic branch-move receipt.
After coordinator close/reopen and deletion of every numerical checkpoint, the original operation recovers its original acknowledgment without numerical reads or forward work.
Recovering an old acknowledgment never rewinds a newer branch head.
Incompatible current execution identities are rejected; strict restore still requires complete numerical bytes.
Retrying a completed legacy prepared publication preserves its original move digest.
limits: CPU synthetic backend and filesystem/socket checks, not real GPU/model qualification
An old acknowledgment is historical publication evidence, not a promise that its derived payload remains cached
Legacy operations without checkpoint metadata still require their checked numerical-file recovery path
Automatic computation rebuild after cache eviction remains a separate integration task
No process-kill/power-loss, ENOSPC or broad controller qualification; G1-G5 unchanged
